CustomField.description: What is still owed on this month, or how much was paid over.
CustomField.formula: IF(Amount_Due__c - Amount_Paid__c > 0, "Outstanding: " & TEXT(Amount_Due__c - Amount_Paid__c), IF(Amount_Due__c - Amount_Paid__c < 0, "Overpaid: " & TEXT(Amount_Paid__c - Amount_Due__c), "Fully paid"))
CustomField.label: AM Payment Position
